items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: If I write Lena Horne she'll answer me right away.

ctx.x: And that song has helped me a lot in my work, too, see? So I don't need anything. So anytime any of them get a letter from me, they can just open it and read it, because there's no begging. Because I'm sending everybody that I can think of that needed a little help, sending them

some money. So I hope they will get that. Now, one person that always answers my letters and is as sweet to me as she can be is Lena Horne. If I write Lena Horne she'll answer me right away. And I call her mother, Mrs. Edna Horne, and talk to her all the time. She's as sweet as she can be. Because she was in my first Broadway show with me.
